📅 Buying or selling in 2027? Do these 5 things this December

1️⃣ Check your credit report (free once a year from each bureau)
2️⃣ Get pre-qualified so you know your budget
3️⃣ Start saving for transfer duty and fees
4️⃣ Selling? Get a valuation and sort out your certificates
5️⃣ Make a shortlist: areas, schools, commute, budget

Thank you for following along this month 🙏 Comment 2027 and tell me your plan. 👇
